name: overseas-trending-search
description: Cross-platform trending search across X, TikTok and YouTube in one query

interface.shortDescription: Cross-platform trending search across X, TikTok and YouTube in one query
interface.longDescription: Search any keyword (Chinese/English/other) across X (Twitter), TikTok and YouTube at once. Returns each platform's Top N trending posts in a unified list (platform/title/author/views/likes/comments/date/link). Language-aware ranking: Chinese keywords surface Chinese content first, English keywords surface English content first. Grouped terminal table + CSV export + interactive HTML report (card/table views).
defaultPrompt: Cross-platform trending search across X, TikTok and YouTube in one query
